aggregation: Equal native checkpoints per dimension. Six-decimal weights distribute integer micro-point remainders in fixed catalog order; this is a new serialization version. Native one-decimal diagnostic totals are retained only in run artifacts.

d6.compatibility: Public result format 2.1 records the actual native multi-state/three-round protocol. It does not silently migrate old scores or assert equivalence with a different D6 protocol.
d6.reference_scope: Bounded adaptations as declared by each fixed reference manifest; not a claim of faithful upstream-game recreation.
